relationships.title: Learning Foundation
relationships.description: Training Data trains Machine Learning models by providing examples that the algorithm learns patterns from.

relationships.title: Algorithm Architecture
relationships.description: Machine Learning implements Neural Networks as one of its most powerful architectures for pattern recognition.

relationships.title: Depth Expansion
relationships.description: Neural Networks evolve into Deep Learning when multiple hidden layers are added, enabling hierarchical feature learning.

relationships.title: Modern Architecture
relationships.description: Deep Learning powers Transformers, the revolutionary architecture that uses self-attention to process sequential data.

relationships.title: Language Understanding
relationships.description: Transformer architecture enables Large Language Models to understand and generate human-like text at scale.

relationships.title: User Interaction
relationships.description: Large Language Models respond to Prompts, interpreting user instructions to generate relevant and contextual outputs.

relationships.title: Creative Direction
relationships.description: Prompts guide Generative AI to create specific content, from text and images to code and music.

relationships.title: Vector Representation
relationships.description: Training Data converts to Embeddings, transforming words and concepts into numerical vectors that capture semantic meaning.

relationships.title: Context Weighting
relationships.description: Embeddings are processed by Attention Mechanisms, which weigh the importance of different parts of the input.

relationships.title: Self-Attention
relationships.description: Attention Mechanism is the core of Transformers, allowing the model to focus on relevant parts of the input sequence.

relationships.title: Error Correction
relationships.description: Backpropagation trains Neural Networks by propagating errors backward through layers to adjust weights.

relationships.title: Weight Update
relationships.description: Gradient Descent optimizes Backpropagation by determining how much to adjust each weight to minimize error.

relationships.title: Specialization
relationships.description: Training Data enables Fine-Tuning, allowing pre-trained models to specialize on specific tasks or domains.

relationships.title: Domain Adaptation
relationships.description: Fine-Tuning customizes Large Language Models for specific use cases, improving performance on targeted tasks.

relationships.title: Prediction Phase
relationships.description: Large Language Models perform Inference when generating responses, using learned patterns without further training.

relationships.title: Text Encoding
relationships.description: Tokenization processes Prompts by breaking text into smaller units that the model can understand and process.

relationships.title: Token Vectors
relationships.description: Tokenization converts to Embeddings by mapping each token to its corresponding vector representation.

relationships.title: Forward Pass
relationships.description: Neural Networks execute Inference through a forward pass, computing outputs from inputs without updating weights.

relationships.title: Foundation Architecture
relationships.description: Generative AI is built on Transformer architecture, leveraging its ability to model complex patterns and relationships.

relationships.title: Learning Algorithm

relationships.title: Production Use

relationships.title: Context Understanding
